title: Agent UI configuration
description: Written to .agent.json by `agent-ui init`. Records where the vendored agent-ui source lives and the install-time hash of every scaffolded file.

cli.description: Version of the CLI that scaffolded this install.

dir.description: Where the vendored agent-ui source lives, relative to the project root.

content.description: Markdown content directory for site knowledge, relative to the project root.

files.description: sha256 of every scaffolded file at install time, keyed by path relative to `dir`. Lets a future `agent-ui update` tell edited files from untouched ones.
